network.num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the directed network.
network.num_arcs: <int> Total number of directed physical arcs in the network.
network.nodes: <list[int], length num_nodes> Identifiers for all nodes in the network.

arcs.from_node: <int> Node where this directed arc originates.
arcs.to_node: <int> Node where this directed arc terminates.
arcs.capacity: <int> Maximum total bandwidth that can flow through this arc across all commodities.
arcs.cost: <int> Per-unit routing cost for any commodity using this arc.

commodities.num_commodities: <int> Total number of commodities (call groups) to be routed or rejected.

commodity_list.destination: <int> Node where this commodity must be delivered.
commodity_list.revenue: <int> Revenue earned if this commodity is successfully routed through the physical network.
commodity_list.artificial_arc_cost: <int> Cost incurred if this commodity is rejected instead of being routed.

objective: <str> Direction of optimization for the total routing and rejection cost.
